summary: Completed testing of Technology Selector Quiz feature - all 21 test cases passed. The quiz correctly guides users through 5 questions (application, viewing distance, environment, priority, budget) and provides rule-based LED technology recommendations. Lead gate form works correctly with validation and API submission.

Step 1 of 5 shown with correct question 'What type of project is this?'

Progress bar shows 20% at Step 1
Clicking option advances to next step (Step 2 of 5)
Step 2: 4 viewing distance options present (close, mid, far, very-far)
Progress bar updates to 40% at Step 2
Back button works - returns to previous step
Step 3: 4 environment options present (indoor-controlled, indoor-bright, semi-outdoor, outdoor)

MicroLED test flow: Hospitality > Under 2m > Indoor Controlled > Image Quality > Premium = MicroLED recommended (CORRECT)
Outdoor/WOW test flow: Outdoor > 10m+ > Fully Outdoor > WOW Factor > Mid = Media Facade recommended with 3D Anamorphic as Alternative 1 (CORRECT)
